name: mhor/php-mediainfo
reason: Documented local media probe wrapper, but the required mediainfo CLI is absent on this host; no pinned release control run yet.

name: owen-oj/laravel-getid3
reason: Popular getID3 Laravel wrapper; a pinned release, minimal framework setup, and valid ID3v2 control are not yet verified.

name: lukasreschke/id3parser
reason: ID3Parser predecessor/fork lead; source relationship, pinned release, and local control remain to be checked.

name: wapmorgan/media-file
reason: Metadata wrapper depends on an older mp3info version; it needs an isolated lock and local control check.

name: phansys/getid3
reason: Namespaced getID3 fork; a documented local API and pinned control check remain to be done.

name: falahati/php-mp3

name: pecl/id3
reason: PECL documents a third-party ID3 extension with only old alpha releases; PHP 8.5 build compatibility and a local control run are unverified. It is not a bundled runtime API.

name: b-b3rn4rd/phplame
reason: The documented package wraps the LAME encoder; no local MP3/ID3 input parsing API was established from the registry description.
